schema.description:
[atomic] One independently true/false primary relation, retaining its full subjects, objects, negation, conditions and qualifiers. Separate independent mechanisms, metrics, datasets and results. A comparison can be one relation with two methods; multiple entities or punctuation alone do not make it compound. Keep a single conditional relation intact; do not invent separate experiments from one jointly reported result. Missing paper support is not non-atomic; a lost report premise is a fidelity defect, not automatically a second relation.
[classification] Determine correct_kind from content independently of the assigned kind; The host derives agreement with the assigned kind; never silently change the denominator. Scientific includes mechanisms, results, empirical comparisons, established classifications, limitations and research-proposal premises. runtime_method means actual execution queries, dates, sources, counts or procedures, checked only against host records, never inferred from prose. report_structure means only this report's organization, chosen scope, aims or grouping. A choice not to rank methods is organization; a claim that cited materials lack comparable results concerns source content and needs evidence. Split mixed statements; their scientific premises remain scientific. Headings, 'this review', hedging, proposals, matching text or absent citations never exempt science. Keep the report language.
[fidelity] source_faithful compares extraction ONLY to its owning report fragment, including same-unit context for subjects and qualifiers, never borrowed citations. Preserve entity, number, condition, negation, qualifier and citation ownership and logical scope: 'cannot infer P' is not 'infer not-P'. Ambiguous ownership is unverifiable. A faithfully extracted uncited claim can have true fidelity but no paper support. A paper's 60 cannot repair report 30 extracted as 60. Neither location equality nor paper entailment establishes classification or report fidelity.
[support] Science uses ONLY this claim's allowed_support_ids and complete original intervals reached through its own citations, not model knowledge, candidates, another claim or neighboring context. The allowed set is permission; basis may be a sufficient subset or combine passages. An unused citation alone is not attribution_mismatch; assess its relevance separately. Select actual findings, not introductory motivation or window previews. full_original is not automatic support. document_subject only resolves that paper's we/our, never proves a mechanism or result. Do not guess aliases, spelling, ownership or PDF word breaks. Partial negatives may keep basis for established aspects; missing aspects stay false. Non-scientific or baseless decisions use empty basis. Runtime compares host_runtime_record only; absent records are unverifiable, explicit not-performed records can support an honest disclosure.
[aspects] Check all and only required_support_aspects once using selected basis IDs; emit no extra N/A true/false rows. The full claim still needs checking: keep genuine defects in the relevant required check and status, never omit them. predicate includes full subject/method ownership, relation, object/comparator and polarity; a paper comparing A/B does not prove B's mechanism. conditions includes task, dataset, model, training/hardware setup and applicability. quantities binds object, metric, value, unit, direction and average/peak: FLOPs is not speed, top-5 not top-1, percent not percentage points, reduced TO not BY, up-to not average. Dimensions, resolution and counts are quantities; digits in names are not automatically results. causal_relation checks the actual causal or inferential relation and its cited premises. Bounded synthesis may reason from full cited originals; missing supplied text cannot prove different conditions, field-wide absence, not-P or causation. Lack of grounds to infer P is not evidence for not-P. Negated protocol labels are not positive results. Entity/number overlap or plausibility is insufficient.
[consistency] Determine kind, atomicity and report fidelity independently, then basis and required aspects, then a consistent status/reason. Supported science needs valid cited basis covering every required aspect. A negative aspect prevents supported; with faithful atomic classification and fully established aspects, do not return unsupported. Never force a positive aspect to obtain a status. Wrong entity/method/setting/number uses attribution_mismatch; absent/weaker support insufficient_support; no citation uncited_claim; unknown unverifiable. This consistency check is not scientific proof or permission to change prose.
[complete] Completeness means faithful coverage of the assigned report inventory, not paper support. Unsupported but faithful science can be completely extracted. Include scientific and other assertions, exclusions, tables, Abstract and Conclusion. Matching IDs, processing or exclusions do not prove no omissions.

schema.description:
[atomic] One independently true/false primary relation, retaining its full subjects, objects, negation, conditions and qualifiers. Separate independent mechanisms, metrics, datasets and results. A comparison can be one relation with two methods; multiple entities or punctuation alone do not make it compound. Keep a single conditional relation intact; do not invent separate experiments from one jointly reported result. Missing paper support is not non-atomic; a lost report premise is a fidelity defect, not automatically a second relation.
[classification] Determine correct_kind from content independently of the assigned kind; The host derives agreement with the assigned kind; never silently change the denominator. Scientific includes mechanisms, results, empirical comparisons, established classifications, limitations and research-proposal premises. runtime_method means actual execution queries, dates, sources, counts or procedures, checked only against host records, never inferred from prose. report_structure means only this report's organization, chosen scope, aims or grouping. A choice not to rank methods is organization; a claim that cited materials lack comparable results concerns source content and needs evidence. Split mixed statements; their scientific premises remain scientific. Headings, 'this review', hedging, proposals, matching text or absent citations never exempt science. Keep the report language.
[fidelity] source_faithful compares extraction ONLY to its owning report fragment, including same-unit context for subjects and qualifiers, never borrowed citations. Preserve entity, number, condition, negation, qualifier and citation ownership and logical scope: 'cannot infer P' is not 'infer not-P'. Ambiguous ownership is unverifiable. A faithfully extracted uncited claim can have true fidelity but no paper support. A paper's 60 cannot repair report 30 extracted as 60. Neither location equality nor paper entailment establishes classification or report fidelity.
[support] Science uses ONLY this claim's allowed_support_ids and complete original intervals reached through its own citations, not model knowledge, candidates, another claim or neighboring context. The allowed set is permission; basis may be a sufficient subset or combine passages. An unused citation alone is not attribution_mismatch; assess its relevance separately. Select actual findings, not introductory motivation or window previews. full_original is not automatic support. document_subject only resolves that paper's we/our, never proves a mechanism or result. Do not guess aliases, spelling, ownership or PDF word breaks. Partial negatives may keep basis for established aspects; missing aspects stay false. Non-scientific or baseless decisions use empty basis. Runtime compares host_runtime_record only; absent records are unverifiable, explicit not-performed records can support an honest disclosure.
[aspects] Check all and only required_support_aspects once using selected basis IDs; emit no extra N/A true/false rows. The full claim still needs checking: keep genuine defects in the relevant required check and status, never omit them. predicate includes full subject/method ownership, relation, object/comparator and polarity; a paper comparing A/B does not prove B's mechanism. conditions includes task, dataset, model, training/hardware setup and applicability. quantities binds object, metric, value, unit, direction and average/peak: FLOPs is not speed, top-5 not top-1, percent not percentage points, reduced TO not BY, up-to not average. Dimensions, resolution and counts are quantities; digits in names are not automatically results. causal_relation checks the actual causal or inferential relation and its cited premises. Bounded synthesis may reason from full cited originals; missing supplied text cannot prove different conditions, field-wide absence, not-P or causation. Lack of grounds to infer P is not evidence for not-P. Negated protocol labels are not positive results. Entity/number overlap or plausibility is insufficient.
[consistency] Determine kind, atomicity and report fidelity independently, then basis and required aspects, then a consistent status/reason. Supported science needs valid cited basis covering every required aspect. A negative aspect prevents supported; with faithful atomic classification and fully established aspects, do not return unsupported. Never force a positive aspect to obtain a status. Wrong entity/method/setting/number uses attribution_mismatch; absent/weaker support insufficient_support; no citation uncited_claim; unknown unverifiable. This consistency check is not scientific proof or permission to change prose.
[complete] Completeness means faithful coverage of the assigned report inventory, not paper support. Unsupported but faithful science can be completely extracted. Include scientific and other assertions, exclusions, tables, Abstract and Conclusion. Matching IDs, processing or exclusions do not prove no omissions.

claim.claim_text: 按信息处理环节，深度K-tuplet、Proto-Triplet/ICNN和MSENet主要改进嵌入空间或多层特征。
claim.source_quote: 本综述比较少样本图像分类中的度量学习方法，范围限定为学习特征嵌入、类别表示或查询—支持相似度，并依据支持样本与未见查询的距离作分类。按信息处理环节，深度K-tuplet、Proto-Triplet/ICNN和MSENet主要改进嵌入空间或多层特征；原型方法与SRL分别以类别原型向量和子空间聚合支持集；关系网络、目标条件化比较器和不确定性框架则把比较函数参数化或解释相似度可靠性。实验证据显示，K-tuplet在miniImageNet及四个跨域数据集上有摘要报告的优势，Proto-Triplet/ICNN在miniImageNet上相对其他度量方法报告2%准确率提升，MSENet覆盖MiniImageNet、FC100的5-way 1/5-shot及八个跨域基准，SRL在MiniImageNet、TieredImageNet和CUB上报告竞争力或更优。 [E:arxiv:2105.08149:page:1:block:9:claim:7cf2d36a262c] [E:arxiv:2010.04525:abstract:claim:7178a9c4f03f] [E:arxiv:2105.08149:abstract:claim:ae8bdfee0e05] [E:arxiv:1907.03123:abstract:claim:5a36249bbf1e] [E:arxiv:2305.09062:abstract:claim:549b9167d596] [E:arxiv:2409.07989:abstract:claim:5ed923dac68f] [E:arxiv:2105.00379:abstract:claim:38498384e907] [E:arxiv:1711.06025:section:abstract:12:43376954155c:claim:71df1568e996] [E:arxiv:1802.04376:abstract:claim:50a611de7d64] [E:arxiv:1907.03123:abstract:claim:998fb93b2a24] [E:arxiv:1907.03123:abstract:claim:b4d49aba47c5] [E:arxiv:2305.09062:abstract:claim:aaed703eb739] [E:arxiv:2105.00379:abstract:claim:e2d40a72c0d6] [E:arxiv:2104.02638:section:abstract:9:1354132472a1:claim:3fb7cfd2fbdb]
